title: Refresh production SEO evidence and prepare bounded approval plan
summary: Fresh read-only backup and schema checks passed; Node 24 tests/build and hosted negative-access probes passed. Prepare a 120-second migration wrapper and separate read-only acceptance gates. No production mutation or deployment.

changes.detail: GET-only hosted probes and read-only transaction-deadline validation; no mutation RPCs invoked.
Fresh immutable read-only production backup, archive comparison, and timestamped schema/preflight evidence.
Prepared original-migration wrapper with 120-second total transaction and 15-second idle limits; original SQL unchanged.
Final approval decision, timing-specific acceptance matrix, stopping conditions and bounded recovery limits.

validation.name: Fresh backup
validation.detail: 18:37:25 UTC backup, 1686628 bytes, 1233 entries, full archive read and repeated SHA-256 checks passed. Exact new snapshot not restored; old restored backup retained.

validation.name: Schema and preflight
validation.detail: 1114 schema blocks match latest archive; 34 products, 4 categories, 6 orders, 8 Auth users; no SEO collision/ledger entry. Last activity check found no >60s transactions or lock waits.

validation.name: Hosted read-only probes
validation.detail: Seven GET probes passed. Invalid Auth token 403, anonymous/invalid Admin API 401, Admin redirect 307, real service PostgREST read 200. No positive user/Admin session exercised.

validation.name: Hosted transaction deadline
validation.detail: Only own READ ONLY session terminated at 1003 ms with PostgreSQL 25P04 after SET LOCAL transaction_timeout=1000ms; no persistent setting or record changed.

validation.name: Node 24
validation.detail: Official Node 24.22.0 SHA-256 verified; candidate 23 tests and production build exit 0. Existing local dependencies/placeholders used; clean Linux hosted install and credential values unverified.

validation.name: Archive comparison
validation.detail: 113 COPY sections compared. Catalogue/order content unchanged; Auth/session/analytics/cron differences recorded. Initial stdout-option error corrected locally; no row contents exposed.

validation.name: Migration, deployment and persistence writes
validation.detail: No migration/deployment/canary/ledger change. New SEO REST/SQL acceptance requires migration; real draft-save/approve/reset/cache checks require separate mutation approval. Recovery actions also require explicit approval.
